Suppose that G is a finitely generated group acting faithfully on a regular
rooted tree by finite-state automorphisms. Is the conjugacy problem decidable for G?
   See the definitions in (R. I. Grigorchuk, V. V. Nekrashevich, V. I. Sushchanskiı̆,
Proc. Steklov Inst. Math., 2000, no. 4 (231), 128–203).
                               R. I. Grigorchuk, V. V. Nekrashevich, V. I. Sushchanskiı̆
